response.sql: WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) as customer_total FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), customer_shares AS (SELECT CustomerId, customer_total, customer_total / (SELECT SUM(customer_total) FROM customer_totals) as share FROM customer_totals), avg_share_calc AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share_value FROM customer_shares), above_average AS (SELECT cs.customer_total, cs.share, asc.avg_share_value FROM customer_shares cs, avg_share_calc asc WHERE cs.share > asc.avg_share_value) SELECT AVG(customer_total) as avg_total_spent, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share_value) as avg_difference FROM above_average
